extracted.intended_audience: grant applicants, PD/PIs, business officials, and signing officials using NIH ASSIST/eRA Commons for OTA and non-research submissions
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and content requirements and validation rules for preparing, validating, and submitting OTA and non-research grant applications using NIH's ASSIST system (including non‑competing continuations and multi‑project applications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Select appropriate amendment type
rubrics_metrics.description: Once the grant to be amended is located, click Initiate and select the most appropriate amendment option (Budget Revision; Carryover Request; Change in Scope; Key Personnel; Merger, Transfer, etc; No-Cost Extension; Organizational Change).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selecting the correct amendment type opens the amendment-specific forms in ASSIST; SF424 and Sites forms are always required for amendments and additional non‑research-specific forms may be required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required forms auto-load (and may be added manually)
rubrics_metrics.description: All required forms should automatically load into ASSIST for the NOFO and amendment type selected, but some forms may be added manually as well.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Forms that may be included: SF424, SF424A, SF424B, SF424C, SF424D, SFLLL, Project Abstract Summary, Budget Narrative Attachment, Project Narrative Attachment, Other Attachments; consult the NOFO and Non-Research Forms for additional info.

rubrics_metrics.name: SF424 and Sites forms required for amendments
rubrics_metrics.description: The SF424 and Sites forms are always required for post-award amendment applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Other forms may also be required depending on the amendment and NOFO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Filter/Search tools for locating grants
rubrics_metrics.description: If search results are long, use the Filter tool to find specific grants or grants with specific criteria (for example specific PD/PI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Search and hitlist screens support SO and PD/PI role-specific workflows (e.g., SOs can search for due grants).

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiate continuation/OTA applications via eRA Commons/ASSIST
rubrics_metrics.description: Non‑competing continuation and OTA applications must be initiated in eRA Commons and prepared/submitted in ASSIST; OTA applications require entering the OTA ROA (opportunity) number and required fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: NOFO instructions supersede the guide. Organizations and PD/PIs must be registered in eRA Commons; a Signing Official (SO) role is required; additional registrations (e.g., SAM) are required if awarded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields are marked with asterisks and must be completed
rubrics_metrics.description: The Initiate Application screen and OTA Core form contain required elements marked with red asterisks (*); all fields marked by an asterisk are required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Type of Application is required. Missing required fields will prevent validations and submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: All attachments must be non-fillable PDF
rubrics_metrics.description: All attachments should be in the format of a non-fillable PDF.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If unsure whether a PDF is fillable, print to a PDF writer or contact the eRA Service Desk. Attachments should follow NOFO-specific PDF requirements and have unique file names when multiple attachments are added.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment filename uniqueness
rubrics_metrics.description: If multiple attachments are added, each should have a unique file name.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use meaningful, distinct filenames to avoid confusion and ensure correct assembly of the application PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project title character limit
rubrics_metrics.description: The descriptive title of the applicant’s project is required and is limited to 200 characters, including spaces and punctuation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter a concise descriptive title that fits within the 200‑character limit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization and address field requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Organization Name, Street 1, City, and Country are required for the Applicant Organization; State and ZIP/Postal Code become required upon Country = United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ZIP/Postal Code must be entered in ZIP+4 nine‑digit format for U.S. entries. Province is enabled and required for Canada; other non‑US country rules apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: EIN/TIN entry format
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter either the organization's Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) or Employer Identification Number (EIN) as assigned by the IRS; if not in the United States, enter 44-4444444.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: EINs may be up to 12 digits—enter all digits provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project period date constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: Enter the proposed project Start Date (estimate) and End Date (estimate). The project period should not exceed what is allowed in the ROA and the End Date must occur after the Start Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure dates comply with ROA limits and internal planning.

rubrics_metrics.name: PD/PI affiliation and multi-PD/PI leadership plan
rubrics_metrics.description: The PD/PI listed must be affiliated with the applicant organization in eRA Commons. For multiple PD/PIs, enter the primary PD/PI first and upload a leadership plan if the NOFO requires one.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leadership plan should describe governance and organizational structure, communication plans, decision‑making processes for scientific direction, conflict resolution procedures, roles/responsibilities, and budget/resource distribution. Attach leadership plan as a PDF per PDF requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Credential/prefill PD/PI via eRA username
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact PD/PI fields can be manually entered or prefilled using an eRA username (Pre-fill Application from Commons Username).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefill works only if the eRA username has a PI role with the selected Lead Applicant Organization; otherwise an error displays and manual entry is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assurances and certifications checkbox required
rubrics_metrics.description: The applicant organization must verify eligibility and the accuracy/conformity of administrative, fiscal, and scientific information and select 'I agree' to provide required certifications and assurances.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deliberate withholding, falsification, or misrepresentation can result in administrative action, debarment, and/or criminal/civil penalties; the signer certifies accountability for appropriate use of funds and performance of the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human subjects reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer yes or no to human subjects involvement; if yes, indicate whether the studies are exempt from Federal Regulations and, if required by the ROA, select and complete the Human Subject Clinical Trial Information Form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow instructions in the SF424 instruction guide for the specific human subjects form(s) required by the NOFO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstract content and length
rubrics_metrics.description: The project abstract must be a succinct and accurate description of the proposed work, understandable to a scientifically literate reader, including broad long‑term objectives and a description of research design; limited to one page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the abstract as a PDF and follow the PDF requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims attachment
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific Aims should be attached as a PDF file per the PDF requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow any NOFO-specific content/format instructions for Specific Aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cover letter purpose and content
rubrics_metrics.description: The cover letter is for internal use only and should include any special considerations or explanatory details regarding the submission; include the application title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the cover letter as a PDF per PDF requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Save and locking behaviors
rubrics_metrics.description: At the bottom of the form, use Save and Keep Lock (saves and restricts data entry to current user), Save and Release Lock (saves and releases form to other users), or Cancel and Release Lock (does not save and releases to other users).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Editing blocks other users until the lock is released or expires; use Release options to allow collaborators to continue work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation required before submission (errors vs warnings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Before submission an application (or component) must pass system and business validations; errors must be corrected before submission; warnings do not prevent submission but should be reviewed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Validation checks run automatically on status updates or can be run manually. Validation results display on the Application Errors and Warnings Results page; messages will indicate if validations passed ('No errors or warnings were found').

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation scope and access levels
rubrics_metrics.description: To validate the entire application, a user must have the 'Entire Application Editor - All (both Budget and Non-Budget)' access level; to validate a component, a user must have 'Editor - All (both Budget and Non-Budget)' access for that component.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASSIST users can choose to validate the entire application or individual components as desired.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validations not performed for missing components/forms or Abandoned components
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST cannot perform all validation checks if required components or forms are missing; ASSIST does not perform validations on components in Abandoned status.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Error messages will indicate missing components/forms on the Application Errors and Warnings Results page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Errors and Warnings Results content and sorting
rubrics_metrics.description: When validation fails, the Application Errors and Warnings Results page lists Component ID & Title (multi‑project only), Form Name, and Error Message for each issue.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The errors/warnings list is sortable by column; errors must be fixed before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Senior/Key Personnel biosketch rules
rubrics_metrics.description: ASSIST allows one biosketch per senior/key person in the final application even if that person is on multiple components; upon finalizing a component ASSIST checks for duplicate biosketches and prompts selection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ASSIST identifies definite matches by matching credentials and potential matches by matching First Name, Last Name, and Organization Name when credentials are not provided. When duplicates are found, the user must indicate whether the entries are the same person and then select which biosketch to include; the unselected biosketch is removed from its component.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Biosketch workflow
rubrics_metrics.description: When potential or definite matched senior/key persons are identified, ASSIST displays Select Senior/Key Person and Select Biosketch pages to confirm identity and choose which biosketch to include.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users may view biosketches by component link, choose the radio button for the desired biosketch, submit the selection, or cancel (which prevents the component from being updated to Final).

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission privileges and AOR credentials
rubrics_metrics.description: Only users with appropriate privileges (Signing Official who is an Authorized Organizational Representative) can submit an application; the Submit Application action prompts for Grants.gov AOR credentials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are Grants.gov credentials, not ASSIST or eRA Commons credentials. After submission, ASSIST updates status to Submitted, records dates/times, sends notifications, and stores status history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ready for Submission status required
rubrics_metrics.description: An application can be submitted only when it is in Ready for Submission status, which requires passing all system and business validations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Update Submission Status to change to Ready for Submission; you may optionally add a comment when updating status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-business-day application viewing window
rubrics_metrics.description: After submitting, there is a two business day application viewing window to check the assembled application; the application automatically moves forward after the window unless explicitly 'rejected' in eRA Commons Status module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For administrative supplements, the Signing Official may skip the two‑day viewing window by clicking the Verify link in the Status module (see eRA Commons help).

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-project application submission prerequisites
rubrics_metrics.description: To prepare a multi‑project application for submission, at least one component must be Final and other components must be Final or Abandoned, and the application status must be 'All Components Final'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Perform validations to reach 'All Components Validated' and then Update Submission Status to Ready for Submission before the Signing Official can submit.

rubrics_metrics.name: OTA Core form editing lock behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Click Edit on the OTA Core tab to begin data entry; in edit mode data entry by other users is blocked until the lock‑holder either releases the lock or it expires.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Save and Release Lock to allow others to continue work; unsaved Cancel and Release Lock discards changes and releases the lock.

rubrics_metrics.name: Browser and popup settings for correct display/validation
rubrics_metrics.description: Some screens may not display correctly in Internet Explorer with Compatibility Mode; turn off Compatibility Mode or use a different browser. Pop‑up blockers can interfere with Validation and the Application Errors and Warnings Results page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add an exception for the NIH domain (*.nih*) in browser security settings to allow popups.

rubrics_metrics.name: NOFO instructions supersede the ASSIST guide
rubrics_metrics.description: Use these instructions together with the forms and information found in the funding opportunity announcement; the NOFO instructions always supersede these application instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully follow NOFO-specific forms, deadlines, page/attachment limits, and content requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preview assembled application before final submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Click Preview Application to view the assembled PDF version of the application; this assembled image is nearly identical to what reviewers/evaluators will assess.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Preview to verify assembled content during the viewing window; ensure attachments and formatting appear as intended.
